name: session-readiness-toolkit
description: A suite for session readiness, starting with authoring-readiness-checks: inspects the host repository, confirms the sorted concerns with the user, interviews for every remedy, and writes a per-repository kit — a SessionStart hook that reports what the machine is missing and what each absence forbids and installs only regenerable state behind a probe, a shared probe library, an on-demand diagnosing skill, a troubleshooting doc keyed by symptom, and a self-check. Re-runs update the kit in place. Ships no hook of its own and never installs anything itself.
